description:
lex1dx is a fast 1-D k-means clustering library: it splits a set of numbers into k contiguous bins with least squared error. Uses include scalar quantization, binning and histogram design.

It has a C++17 core, Python and R bindings to that core, and a Scala port. All four share one API: cluster(x, k) with optional mode, sig, M, weights and solver. Python, R and Scala bundle two example datasets. Python and R also have histogram() and bin_table().

The method is described in the paper LEX: Fast scalar quantization by grouping and local exchanges (Sriram, 2026), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24543220.
